content.text:
In this task, you need to make electricity using one of the six energy sources shown.

First, move an energy source into the energy chain.

To find out more about an energy source, select the i.

Now move the correct energy converters into
the chain.

To find out more about a converter, or to work out its position in an energy chain, select i.

This energy chain can only use up to six converters.

Remove anything that is incorrect and then select Complete energy chain.
This energy chain does not have enough converters to complete the chain.

That's not right.

The converters are not in the correct order. Move any incorrect items back to the menu and rebuild the chain.
Now move each statement to the correct stage in the process.

Still not right.

Look closely and see if you can remember what is happening.

Still not right.

You need to find what the [CONVERTER] does at this stage of the process.

Well done!

You can print out your energy chain now or select Save energy chain to print it out later.
Select Start again to make another energy chain.

Well done!

You can print out your energy chain now or select
Save energy chain to print it out later.

If you want to have another go, select Build again.

Your energy chain has been saved.

You can print out your energy chain or build one again.
